description: Fetch an RSS 2.0, RSS 1.0 or Atom feed and return normalized JSON items (title, link, published_at ISO 8601, summary without HTML, author, guid). Use for monitoring blogs, news sites, GitHub releases, podcasts or any feed URL without writing an XML parser. Params: url (required), limit (default 20, max 100). Price: $0.005 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base or Solana). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"url":"https://hnrss.org/frontpage","limit":10}.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return
